worst_case.statement: A statically scheduled machine has a knowable ceiling: the saturated schedule (every die issuing every cycle) IS its worst case, so it can be provisioned at 1.2x that ceiling rather than at nameplate. GPUs cannot: measured draw depends on the workload and spikes past TDP, so operators provision at nameplate and oversubscribe (Fan/Weber/Barroso; POLCA).
